data.name: Mahadesora
data.detailed_description:
In this fate-tangled turn-based RPG, you play as Kunzai — a lost hero drowning in destiny. Team up with your destined partner and eccentric allies to explore a world of sand and sea, uncover the meaning of “Kun-life,” face snarky teammates, and try not to get emotionally wrecked by your own drama.

The Story

The Sun Kingdom once shone with glory—until its brilliance began to fade.
As darkness spreads across the land, the prophecy of a “Kunzai of light” comes true with the birth of Lumos.
But the journey to restore the kingdom’s radiance will be anything but easy.

Take on the role of Lumos and set out on a grand adventure. Gather loyal companions, seek the Great Master’s guidance, and grow stronger through countless trials. Only by awakening true light can Lumos bring prosperity back to the kingdom—and to the world itself.

Character Progression

Level up by gaining experience in battle, unlocking new spells and abilities as you grow.

Equip weapons, armor, and accessories to enhance your stats and customize your playstyle. Every choice matters as you forge your path toward the light.

Goals

Follow the main story as you:

  • Recruit trusted allies and uncover their unique stories.

  • Explore monster-infested caves and uncover hidden treasures.

  • Confront the misguided king and reveal the truth behind the kingdom’s fall.

Side quests await those who seek rare and powerful items scattered across the world.

Challenges

Some enemies are far stronger than they appear.

To survive, you’ll need to raise your level, master elemental magic, and plan every move carefully. Strategy is the key to victory.

Game Mechanics

Engage in turn-based battles where timing and tactics decide the outcome. Combine spells and items for devastating combos, and discover hidden treasures as you explore the world’s many maps and dungeons.

Play Time

The main story takes about 2.5–3 hours to complete.

For players who wish to uncover every secret and item, full completion takes around 3–3.5 hours.

Genre

A fantasy-style JRPG inspired by classic adventures—short, heartfelt, and full of magic.

Soundtrack

Immerse yourself in a world where music tells the story:

  • In towns, deep and solemn themes echo the weight of history.

  • In the wild, bright and gentle melodies celebrate the beauty of nature.

Additional Game Modes

There are no extra modes or endless loops—just a complete, fulfilling adventure that can be experienced in a single playthrough.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10（64 位）或更高
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4340 或相当性能
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 支持 OpenGL，显存至少 1 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10（64 位）或更高
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 系列或同等级 AMD 处理器
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 支持 OpenGL，显存至少 2 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
